description:
Makoto Ito is a young Japanese high school student beginning his second term at the fictional Sakakino Academy. During his daily train rides to and from school, he becomes infatuated with fellow student Kotonoha Katsura; a girl that also commutes. When a new classmate acquaintance of his, Sekai Saionji, discovers his secret crush on Kotonoha, she helps introduce both of them to each other and over time they grow closer and agree to date. However in spite of her proud and triumphant matchmaking efforts, Sekai inadvertently becomes jealous of the new couple, having also developed feelings toward Makoto.

The following afternoon on her way home at the nearby train station in front of the school, Sekai finds Makoto waiting for Kotonoha to rendezvous for a date. He sits with her and reiterates his appreciation for her help, and feeling heavily indebted, offers repayment anyway he can. Though she believes he is overreacting, Sekai decides to redeem her obligation by placing a kiss on his lips as her train pulls in; quickly rushing into an open passenger car and happily bidding a dumbstruck Makoto luck on his date.

(Source: Wikipedia)

**Height:** 167.5 cm (5’6”)

Makoto Ito is the protagonist of the series. A generally mannered and composed student in year one of class three, his life becomes complicated when he begins to unfaithfully initiate numerous relationships with girls that he is unable to singly commit to. Though he is initially casual, gregarious and understanding, his addiction to sex over time corrupts his personality and he instead becomes more apathetic, rash and egotistical towards others, regardless of interpersonal harm or later consequence. However, once he truly knows he has done wrong, he is quick in his attempts to remedy the situation.

Makoto lives with his divorced mother and has a younger sister name Itaru who lives with their father. He is good friends with [Taisuke Sawanaga](https://anilist.co/character/5275/Sawanaga-Taisuke) and [Otome Katou](https://anilist.co/character/4085/Katou-Otome).

**Height:** 156.7 cm (5’2”)

A shy, quiet girl from class 1-4, one door down from [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) and [Sekai](https://anilist.co/character/3360/Saionji-Sekai)'s class.

Due to her striking appearance, she's always been somewhat frightened of boys. She is disliked by the girls in her class, and distanced from the boys, who restrain each other from approaching her. Having taken an interest in Makoto as he watches her from afar, she decides to accept when he confesses with the help of Sekai's mediation.

**Height:** 155 cm (5’1”)

Also in year 1, class 3, she is [Makoto's](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) classmate. Sitting next to him in class, she sees the picture that Makoto has secretly taken of [Kotonoha](https://anilist.co/character/3359/Katsura-Kotonoha) on his mobile phone. She then helps him get close to Kotonoha despite harboring strong feelings for him.

Even though she is good-natured her emotions overwhelm her in many situations. She lives with her mother in an apartment.  Known to be both a cheerful mood-maker and somewhat of a loudmouth. Her cute appearance and bright personality (as admired by [Taisuke](https://anilist.co/character/5275/Sawanaga-Taisuke)) attract a lot of secret fans, but with her frank and outspoken personality, all the boys who've confessed to her so far have been mercilessly rejected.

**Height:** 142 cm

Also in Year 1, Class 3, Setsuna is a member of the class committee and is childhood friends with [Sekai](https://anilist.co/character/3360/Saionji-Sekai). Their mothers are good friends and they work together at the same company.

Setsuna is constantly worried about Sekai and tries to make sure that [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) will keep Sekai happy. This leads her to go so far as to try to eradicate [Kotonoha](https://anilist.co/character/3359/Katsura-Kotonoha) from Makoto's love life by cutting short any interactions they had while she was around, although this was only done for Sekai's sake and she didn't harbor real ill feelings towards Kotonoha herself.

Although silent-looking and almost emotionless, she is conscious about her underdeveloped body, especially in comparison with Kotonoha and Sekai.

**Height:** 161 cm

Temperamental and fastidious, Hikari Kuroda is a student in year one of class three, recognizable by her signature squid rings hairstyle. She initially believes that Makoto and Sekai are dating from the very start, and tends to negatively generalize him; later growing closer to him herself.     Though she is actually quite friendly and social, Hikari is the most childish of the cast; sporting an unduly knack for whining and prying into the affairs of others. Her family owns a confectionery store and café, famous for its lemon custard pie. Hikari is good friends with Sekai and has an unreciprocated crush on Taisuke Sawanaga.

**Height:** 164 cm

She is in year 1 class 4 of Sakakino Gakuen, and one of [Makoto's](https://anilist.co/character/3358/Itou-Makoto) friends since junior high.

She's in girl's basketball team, and also is the head of the group of girls who bullies [Kotonoha](https://anilist.co/character/3359/Katsura-Kotonoha). She has always had a crush on Makoto since junior high. Although she has feelings for Makoto ever since junior high, he does not seem to think of her romantically. While Kotonoha dates Makoto, Otome is extremely irritated and jealous when before, she thought the relationship was one-sided.

A friend of Sekai's that used to go to the same school with her. Nanami is in year 1, class 3. She was offered admission to the school based on her special athletic talents. 

Her boyfriend is also her senior and is in the school's basketball club. Her boyfriend is a hardcore otaku.

Kotonoha's younger sister. Unlike her shy older sister, she is very talkative, full of curiosity, and likes to tease Kotonoha around, but she actually worries about Kotonoha a lot. She often wants to play with Makoto during his visits at her house.
